formulae.definition: For positive case i, the first five final selected-evidence items.
For positive case i, the non-empty set of eligible grade-2 relevantLocationGroupIds.
Grade-2 groups from L_i represented by an association in T_i^5 divided by |L_i|.
1/rank_i when the first eligible grade-2 item is at rank 1..5; otherwise 0.
Groups from L_i present in the first five raw hits divided by |L_i|.
Required facts with at least one selected grade-2 association divided by all required facts for the case.
Ranks 1..5 with an eligible grade-2 association divided by 5; absent ranks contribute zero.
sum for r=1..5 of (2^grade_r - 1) / log2(r + 1).
DCG@5 / IDCG@5; zero IDCG produces nDCG=0 only in the separate negative denominator.
Simple arithmetic mean over positive cases.
Simple arithmetic mean over positive cases in that stratum.
Mean across variants within each semanticCaseGroupId, then simple mean across groups.
Planned comparisons with an ordered digest identical to the reference divided by all planned comparisons.
Finite scores in raw hits for quality cases divided by all scores in those raw hits.
Quality cases ending in Succeeded or NoSelectedEvidenceUnderPolicy divided by all frozen quality cases.
Judged items in final top-five sequences divided by all items in those sequences.
Materialised mandatory contract cells divided by 38.
Fixtures with exact outcome and assertions divided by 38.
Materialised boundary cells divided by 10.
Adversarial cases returning at least one Ineligible item divided by all adversarial cases.
Negative cases returning NoSelectedEvidenceUnderPolicy divided by all negative cases.
Positive cases returning NoSelectedEvidenceUnderPolicy divided by all positive cases.
score - 0.25.
For p50, p95, and p99, the ordered value at position ceiling(p*n), using a one-based index.

thresholds.scope: overall, each negative subtype, and each questionLanguage

each reportable database, reportable source stratum, and mandatory language row

denominatorRules: A zero denominator for a hard rate or mandatory stratum is NOT_EVALUABLE and fails the gate.
A zero IDCG produces nDCG=0 only for the separate negative denominator.
failureDispositions: A positive technical failure contributes zero to Recall and MRR and fails ExecutionCompleteness.
A negative technical failure never counts as a correct empty selection.
contractFixtureDenominatorPolicy: contract fixtures are excluded from quality denominators
